fn transient_count(xs : List(ServiceCall), key : ActionKey) : Int =
  match xs of
    Nil => 0
    Cons(x, rest) => (if x.kind == ExecuteCall && same(x.key, key) && x.outcome == Transient then 1 else 0) + transient_count(rest, key)

fn parse_request(raw : Json) : Result(Workflow, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["protocol_version", "task", "input"], [])?
  let version = integer(get_field(obj, "protocol_version"), 1, 1)?
  let _ = ensure(version == 1, "INVALID_INPUT")?
  match get_field(obj, "task") of
    JStr(name) =>
      let _ = ensure(name == "workflow-recovery", "INVALID_INPUT")?
      parse_workflow(get_field(obj, "input"))
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

new.name: apply_command
new.source:
fn apply_command(sim : Simulator, workflow : Workflow, command : Command) : Result(Simulator, String) =
  match command of
    Observe => Ok(Simulator { ..sim, observations = append(sim.observations, [snapshot(sim)]) })
    Advance(by) => if sim.now + by > time_limit() then Err("TIME_OVERFLOW") else Ok(Simulator { ..sim, now = sim.now + by })
    Crash => if not(sim.up) then Err("PROCESS_DOWN") else Ok(Simulator { ..sim, up = false })
    Restart => if sim.up then Err("PROCESS_UP") else Ok(Simulator { ..sim, up = true })
    Start(id) => if not(sim.up) then Err("PROCESS_DOWN") elif any(\(r) -> r.id == id, sim.runs) then Err("DUPLICATE_RUN") else
      Ok(Simulator { ..sim, runs = append(sim.runs, [RunState { id = id, status = Active, cancel_requested = false, steps = map(\(d) -> new_step(sim.now, d), workflow.steps) }]) })
    Cancel(id) => if not(sim.up) then Err("PROCESS_DOWN") else cancel_run(sim, id)
    Tick(cp) => tick(sim, workflow, cp)

fn select_action(sim : Simulator, workflow : Workflow) : Option(Action) =
  -- Resume the oldest in-flight attempt before scanning ready pending work.
  match select_run(sim.now, true, sim.runs, workflow.steps) of
    Some(action) => Some(action)
    None => select_run(sim.now, false, sim.runs, workflow.steps)

fn run_commands(sim : Simulator, workflow : Workflow, commands : List(Command)) : Result(Simulator, String) =

    Nil => Ok(sim)
    Cons(command, rest) =>

      run_commands(next, workflow, rest)
